title: Code to Give — Lemontree
shortDescription: Winner at Morgan Stanley Code to Give USA 2026. Built a full-stack volunteer coordination platform for Lemontree, helping organizers create and run food-access campaigns through an AI conversational campaign builder. The system combines a 3-node LangGraph agent on AWS Bedrock, 12 campaign tools, live pantry discovery, automatic PDF flyers, email invitations, calendar integration, gamification, impact reporting, and a personalized campaign feed.
